title: Klaviyo Management
meta: Klaviyo account audits, fixes and campaign builds for online stores, done inside your own account. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Klaviyo management that keeps your account earning
overview: We work inside your Klaviyo account to find what is leaking revenue and fix it. That starts with a check of your lists, segments, flows, signup forms and sender setup, then a ranked list of what to change first. Depending on the package we also make the fixes, build and schedule campaigns from your copy and images, and hand you a plain-English summary of what changed. You stay the owner of the account, and we never ask for your password.

faq: Do I need to give you my Klaviyo password?
No. You invite us as a user in your Klaviyo account with the access needed for the job. We never ask for your password, and you can remove us whenever you like.
Each package is a one-time job with a fixed price and delivery time. If you want us to look after your account every month, send a brief and we reply with a written quote in US dollars.
Do you write the emails and design the campaigns?

The Standard and Premium packages build and schedule campaigns from the copy and images you send. If you want the writing or the layout design done for you, add the Campaign writing extra or order Newsletter Design.
Do you send to people who did not agree to hear from you?
No. We send only to profiles with a clear opt-in, and we never import bought, scraped or rented lists. That protects your sender reputation and keeps you inside the rules.
